# Money Book

Money Book is a Korean personal finance web app for recording income, expenses,
savings, and investment purchases in a monthly dashboard.

Primary URL: https://money-book-one.vercel.app/

## What the app does

- Tracks income and expense entries by date, category, memo, and amount.
- Summarizes monthly income, spending, savings, and cash flow.
- Visualizes daily cash flow and category spending ratios with charts.
- Supports savings-account style records and stock purchase records.
- Provides a demo mode for trying the core workflows without creating an account.

## Audience

Korean users who want a simple personal bookkeeping dashboard for household
budgeting, expense review, savings tracking, and monthly money-flow analysis.

## Important pages

- `/`: Main app dashboard and demo experience.
- `/auth/login`: Login and demo entry point.
- `/auth/signup`: Account creation.

## Indexing guidance

Use the root page as the canonical public page. Authentication pages are utility
pages and should not be treated as primary search results.
